359:t_1:83.en:
$$ボス$$
「No... he's even worse than back then. Even when $$赤木$$ talks to him, he won't meet his eyes.」

359:t_1:84.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... it's like he even regrets being alive.」

359:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Should we ask $n to coach him? He's almost stopped being the quiet type.」

359:t_1:88.en:
$n
「$$甲児$$... you just said he even regrets being alive.」

359:t_1:90.en:
$n
「I'm sure that's how $$シンジ$$ feels right now. ...All we can really do is wait.」

359:t_1:91.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean there's nothing we can do?」

359:t_1:92.en:
$n
「I hope he can find something himself that helps him move forward, even a little...」

359:t_1:94.en:
$$シュレード$$
(That boy who calls himself $$渚カヲル$$ concerns me, too...)

359:t_1:95.en:
$$シュレード$$
(The boy who appeared to listen to my piano back then... Was that... him...?)

359:t_1:96.en:
$$マリ$$
「Hmm... Puppy has a rough road ahead of him, nya~.」

359:t_1:97.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're still taking everything at your own pace, $$マリ$$.」

359:t_1:98.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, sure. I'm no naive little girl.」

359:t_1:99.en:
$$ノノ$$
「C-could it be... you look like a girl, but your actual age is...!」

359:t_1:100.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She's not an android like you. There's no way that's true.」

359:t_1:102.en:
$$カレン$$
「Aren't you going to wear a school uniform, $$アスカ$$?」

359:t_1:104.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey... tell me what happened to $$シンジ$$.」

359:t_1:105.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We went our separate ways after we got back to our own world, so...」

359:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「But $$アスカ$$, couldn't you ask $$シンジ$$ what happened...」

359:t_1:108.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$カレン$$. We're... not who we were back then anymore...」

359:t_1:110.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I'm tired, too... I'm going to rest...」

359:t_1:114.en:
$$マリ$$
(If it bothers you that much, why don't you just spit it all out?)

359:t_1:115.en:
$$マリ$$
('I look the same, but a lot of time has passed since then, and our world has almost been destroyed,' you know?)

359:t_1:117.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Everyone fought so hard... How could I tell them we ended up in the same state as $$エタニティ・フラット$$ anyway...?)

359:t_1:118.en:
$$マリ$$
(Well... you're right... These kids are kind... They wouldn't know how to react if you told them that...)

359:t_1:120.en:
$$チコ$$
「Hmm... that $$アスカ$$ girl gets called 'Princess,' too.」

359:t_1:121.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Has a rival appeared for Big Sis?!」

359:t_1:122.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... Why do you always take things in that direction?」

359:t_1:123.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because it's so exciting! A rival appears, then comes the first defeat... followed by a comeback through hard work and guts!」

359:t_1:124.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Look... she's going to be our comrade. Why are you thinking about fighting her and losing...?」

359:t_1:128.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(When $$シンジ$$'s group and $$アスカ$$'s group transferred here, it looked like the two groups of EVAs were fighting...)

359:t_1:129.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(What on earth happened to $$シンジ$$ and the others in the three months since they transferred away...?)

359:t_1:130.en:
$$チコ$$
「Still, all those EVA kids look like they've got their quirks.」

359:t_1:133.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Oops, sorry. I forgot one of you was still here.」

359:t_1:134.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You didn't put on a school uniform either, $$レイ#pt394$$?」

359:t_1:135.en:
$$カレン$$
「But won't you get tired staying in that plugsuit?」

359:t_1:136.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「What would $$綾波レイ$$ do... at a time like this?」

359:t_1:139.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is here already...!」

359:t_1:140.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
(What do these people fight for...? Because they're ordered to? Or...)

359:t_2:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「...You've done well, $$ジンネマン$$.」

359:t_2:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Thank you... Chief of Staff $$ナナイ$$ was delighted to hear you'd returned, Colonel, after being missing.」

359:t_2:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm glad you're safe, too, $$マリーダ$$.」

359:t_2:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$c is just like the $$ガランシェール$$ team. I can fight here.」

359:t_2:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジンネマン$$, stay here with the $$ガランシェール$$ team and guard the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

359:t_2:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「I intend to have $$ミネバ$$, $$ナナイ$$, and the others come here eventually, too.」

359:t_2:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Of course, but what will you do, Colonel?」

359:t_2:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I ask you to indulge my selfishness a little longer.」

359:t_2:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You'll be staying with $c, then.」

359:t_2:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「$c needs fighting strength right now. I'll help them as a pilot myself.」

359:t_2:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If I may be so bold, Captain $$アムロ$$ and the others are surely asking more of you than that, Colonel.」

359:t_2:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I'll give it some thought, $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

359:t_2:18.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Understood, Colonel. I'll protect the $$コロニー同盟軍$$ while you're away.」

359:t_2:24.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm counting on you to look after $$マリーダ$$, $$バナージ$$.」
